messages:
maria: heads up — after the heartbeat-v2 rollout we’re seeing a class of streaming sessions that just drop silently after ~45s. clients never get close event and resume tokens sometimes fail to replay
aj: seen it in staging too. looks like gateway is tearing TLS but not sending final SSE `event: close` — want logs from the proxy? :thinking_face:
sahil: past incidents like this were keepalive vs idle-timeout mismatch on the LB. could be our proxy idle timer shorter than client jitter
lex: adding more context: affected clients are long-poll websockets -> we switch to SSE shim. Replay shows `resume_token` present but server responds 500 on resume endpoint 
caroline: curious — any quota anomalies? iirc resume attempts should be counted against the short-term quota and we might be double-billing on retry loops
maria: yes, console metrics spiked for "stream_resume_attempts" and also hunch: resume handler increments usage before auth check, so failed resumes increment usage
aj: oof. that explains billing spikes. easy mitigation: move increment after auth/validation or add a reject-without-count for auth-failures
sahil: for the silent drop, can we diff the proxy vs old runtime? two quick checks: `Connection: keep-alive` vs `Connection: close` headers and LB `timeout` config. also check socket `SO_KEEPALIVE` params
maria: logs snippet from user session (redacted):
```
[2026-03-18T22:10:11Z] conn=xyz state=open
[2026-03-18T22:10:56Z] conn=xyz keepalive=timeout -> dropped (no close event)
[2026-03-18T22:10:56Z] resume_token=abc123 POST /v1/streams/resume -> 500 {"err":"kv-cache-miss"}
```
lex: kv-cache-miss on resume is suspicious — might be TTL too aggressive after runtime gc change last month
caroline: rollout UX note: in the console flagging this as "sse-heartbeat-v2" rollout caused confusion — support started toggling it per-tenant but no guardrail to disable automatic resume attempts; we should add a console hint about resume cost and retry budget
maria: proposed immediate actions: 1) fast rollback flag for sse-heartbeat-v2 on console 2) move resume quota increment to post-auth 3) add a metric for "sse-no-close-event" and alert 4) patch retry budget so clients back off more aggressively
aj: agree. will open a tiny deploy with the quota increment change (no schema changes) — target canary to 5%
sahil: i can instrument the proxy to log header diffs and LB timeouts, push a small config change to increase idle timeout by 30s behind feature flag
lex: i’ll investigate KV TTLs and add an index to make resume idempotent longer-term
caroline: UX: i'll add a one-click rollback button to the rollout modal and a tooltip that surfaces "resume attempts count" so support can triage without paging infra
maria: great. assign owners? aj for quota patch + deploy, sahil for proxy logs/timeouts, lex for kv/ttl, caroline for console UX. i’ll own alert and rollback plan + postmortem skeleton
deploy-bot: deploy queued: quota-fix-canary -> infra-canaries (5%) by aj
ops-bot: alert created: SSE_NoCloseEvent_HIGH — paging eng-runtime on escalation list
aj: pinging support channel with mitigation steps and temp doc for customers to toggle flag if needed
maria: thanks all. let’s reconvene after canary is up and we have the new metric firing. :thumbsup:
